recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-3478; future changes to Media timing should be handled under the later Media issue family rather than this Attachment datatype issue.
issue_request: FHIR-3478 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core datatypes request to add a 0..1 dateTime creation element to Attachment and review resources using Attachment, particularly Media and person-photo elements.
initial_application: Historical commit c1c8b179a9 (#3478, svn revision 4527) added Attachment.creation to source/datatypes/attachment.xml and adjusted Media by removing the then-existing Media.created element while adding Media.content guidance. Commit 6cb3689cb2 later documented Media.content.creation for FHIR-10212.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini routes ordinary datatypes to the datatypes page and marks Attachment normative. Later Media issues FHIR-10212 and FHIR-14144 refine the Media companion area: FHIR-10212 recognized the recording date as Media.content.creation, while FHIR-14144 later added Media.created[x] and Media.issued for Observation alignment. Current Media notes distinguish Media.created[x] from Media.content.creation. FHIR-19823 later added DocumentReference creation search over content.attachment.creation, confirming ongoing use of Attachment.creation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active source already contains Attachment.creation as 0..1 dateTime with the intended semantics, and no additional core source change is needed for the Media/photo review scope after later decisions.

related_jiras.note: Media issue resolved that the recording date was already available through Media.content.creation and added documentation.
Later Media alignment added Media.created[x] and Media.issued, explaining why current Media timing source differs from the original 2015 replacement wording.
Later DocumentReference issue added a search parameter over DocumentReference.content.attachment.creation, confirming Attachment.creation remains a used core element.
